body.message:
We have tried our best, but unfortunately the rate cannot be reduced below AED 5,200.

If you are happy to proceed, kindly allow us to send you the payment link to confirm your extension booking. Once the payment is received, we will proceed with the confirmation.

Please note that payments made via the payment link will include an additional 3.1% transaction fee. If you would prefer to avoid these charges, you may opt for a bank transfer, or we can also arrange cash collection for your convenience, Mr. Mohammad.
